note: Photos is a photo-album module: an album is a node of type 'photos' and each picture is a photos_image content entity. Global behaviour lives in the config object photos.settings (main form route photos.admin.config at /admin/config/media/photos; the 'configure'/field-UI route is photos.admin at /admin/structure/photos). It defines 7 permissions (view/create photo, edit/delete own/any photo, view original) and an upload service photos.upload. Medium/hard cases are grounded ONLY in the photos.settings config object (safe on the shared site); they deliberately avoid creating/deleting album nodes. Baselines: photos_num=5, photos_cover_imagesize=thumbnail, photos_display_list_imagesize=large.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal Photos module, what content type represents a photo album, and how are the individual pictures stored?
evals.expected_output: An album is a node of the 'photos' (Photo album) content type; the individual pictures are stored as photos_image content entities that belong to the album node.

evals.prompt: Where do I configure the Photos module's global settings (image sizes, per-page counts, etc.), and which config object stores them?
evals.expected_output: Global settings are at /admin/config/media/photos (route photos.admin.config, PhotosAdminSettingsForm) and are stored in the photos.settings config object. The structure/field-UI page is /admin/structure/photos (route photos.admin).

evals.prompt: Which permissions does the Photos module define for working with individual photos?
evals.expected_output: It defines: view photo, create photo, edit own photo, delete own photo, edit any photo (restricted), delete any photo (restricted), and view original. Admin/config routes use the core 'administer nodes' permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, how many image upload slots does the Photos upload form show? Inspect the live Photos configuration and give the number.
evals.expected_output: 12 - photos.settings:photos_num is set to 12 on this site.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which image style does the Photos module use for album cover images? Inspect the live Photos configuration and name the image style.
evals.expected_output: The cover image style is 'medium' - photos.settings:photos_cover_imagesize is set to medium.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Photos module so that photos shown in the album LIST view use the 'thumbnail' image style. Apply the change to the live site configuration.
On this Drupal site, configure the Photos module so the image upload form shows 8 upload slots at a time. Apply the change to the live site configuration.
